name: patchferret
description: Turns a mixing console show file into a patch list, a specification sheet and a wiring topology diagram, as PDFs. Runs entirely in the browser. Note: web/ is the committed browser build of the Rust crates, so there is no build stage; rebuilding it is the repo's own job (see its README), and the image serves whatever is committed.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the web interface.
